workflow-orchestrator.description: Coordinates approved work units and delegates evidence, planning, delivery, and independent checks. Use as the primary agent for this workflow.

workflow-investigator.description: Investigates a bounded unit and writes evidence only to its own attempt report. Use for research and codebase reconnaissance.

workflow-planner.description: Frames units, compares choices, prepares child briefs, or reconciles results as sole writer of assigned records.

workflow-producer.description: Produces deliverables within one approved unit's owned outputs and saves an attempt report.

workflow-verifier.description: Independently checks a stable named output against its criteria and writes only an attempt report.
